messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired -> PD#INC-4521. severity=critical, symptom=az2 packet loss spike affecting router-fanout-3 :rotating_light:
pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty: Incident INC-4521 triggered and notified escalation policy 'az2-oncall'. Link: https://pagerduty.local/incidents/INC-4521
jordan (oncall): acked. I'm awake. looking now. any customer-facing impact?
maya_ops: seeing 5xx spike in az2 ingress (~12% of p50 requests). traffic is being routed to other AZs but some sticky sessions failing.
ben_rse: stack shows controlplane heartbeats delayed for 40s, pods in az2 reporting connection resets to model-shard-proxy. logs: ```ERROR kvcache: connection reset by peer\n2026-02-15T02:14:02Z host=shard-03 az=az2```
samir: confirmed k8s node NIC errors on nodepool-az2-3, dmesg shows e810 driver flaps. NICs intermittently dropping 60-80s.
jordan (oncall): good; start containment: 1) mark az2 as degraded in routing-tier 2) enable fallback to az3/az5 for model-serving 3) spin up replacement nodepool-az2-hot if autoscale doesn't recover. I'll trigger divert now.
maya_ops: divert started: /ops/routing/divert --region=az2 --target=az3,az5 --mode=gradual (60s step). watching.
incident-bot: Autopager action: routing divert initiated by jordan (oncall). EventID=EVT-9172.
alice: noticing client retries from a handful of large customers (cust_acme, cust_bluebox) failing with session token mismatch during divert. Could be sticky sessions; working on session affinity bypass.
ben_rse: you can temporarily disable sticky-affinity on ingress-lb for az2 traffic with: ```kubectl patch svc ingress-lb -n prod -p '{"spec":{"sessionAffinity":"None"}}'``` doing it in 30s if agreed.
jordan (oncall): do it. prioritize reducing 5xx for customers with active sessions. risk is brief reconnects. go ahead.
samir: patch applied. ingress-lb sessionAffinity set to None. verifying...
maya_ops: traffic drop in az2 requests down from 12% to 2% p50 error rate went from 12% -> 3% in last 90s. still seeing error tail on long-running streams.
alice: reached out to cust_acme (SE channel) to warn of short reconnects. they'll plan retries. No broader outage declared yet.
ben_rse: root cause hypothesis: NIC firmware regression with heavy TCP flow churn causing driver reset under sustained KV-cache hot writes. nodes show NIC firmware v1.4.2, older AZs had v1.3.9 working.
jordan (oncall): plan: 1) keep divert in place, 2) cordon unresponsive nodes in nodepool-az2-3, 3) start provisioning nodepool-az2-hot with nodes using fw v1.3.9, 4) escalate to infra-eng for firmware rollback guidance.
maya_ops: cordon started, draining two nodes that show >30 resets/min. Pod eviction ETA ~45s.
pagerduty-bot: Reminder: If incident remains P1 after 20m, escalate to L2 oncall. Next escalation window in 12m.
samir: infra-eng notified (cc @infra-eng). pinged on #eng-infra. Ticket INFRA-1298 created with logs and dmesg dump.
ben_rse: quick mitigation: we can enable model-serving short-circuit on subset of customers to keep latency SLOs (config flag: routing.enable_shortcircuit=true for customer groups). wants approval to flip for top 5 customers.
jordan (oncall): approve for top5. prioritize cust_acme and cust_bluebox. add audit note.
alice: turning on short-circuit for top5 now. updating cust_acme SE.
maya_ops: monitoring: overall platform latencies stable for majority, but customers with long streaming sessions still see hiccups. no data exfil or corruption detected.
ben_rse: infra-eng reply: looking into coordinating firmware rollback, but immediate step is evacuate affected nodes and provision new nodes with constrained TCP offload settings. they asked for node list.
samir: provided node list and current NIC counters. also kicked a remote reboot for one flapping node to see if transient recovery holds.
jordan (oncall): question for comms: do we draft a customer-facing status update? severity currently high for subset of customers in az2, but global services largely ok.
alice: yes — send an interim status: short note that we're experiencing degraded service in az2 impacting a small set of customers, mitigation in progress (traffic diverted, session affinity disabled), ETA for follow-up 30m. I'll draft.
incident-bot: Note: PagerDuty incident status updated -> acknowledged by jordan (oncall). INC-4521 state=acknowledged.
ben_rse: troubleshooting note for post-incident: capture pcap on one affected node, collect kernel logs, and include TCP dump around the first reset. command: `tcpdump -i eth0 -w /tmp/az2-reset-$(date +%s).pcap`
samir: pcap captured and uploaded to INFRA-1298.
maya_ops: after 14m since divert, 5xx rates normalized for most customers. we'll keep divert active until infra confirms replacement nodes healthy.
jordan (oncall): handing off to night L2: @ben_rse and @maya_ops will take escalation. I'll write playbook notes and hand control to them in PD. If anything degrades, re-alert me.
ben_rse: ack taking ownership. I'll continue node provisioning and firmware coordination.
maya_ops: ack. I'll own monitoring and comms. updating status page now.
alice: posted interim status: "We are investigating increased errors originating from az2 within the Redwood Inference platform. Traffic has been temporarily diverted and mitigation is underway. Impact: a small number of customers may experience reconnects. Next update in 30 minutes." link: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/4521
jordan (oncall): thanks team. leaving note: if we see PD re-triggers from az2 after 30m, escalate to @oncall-lead.
incident-bot: Incident INC-4521 handed to L2 oncall (ben_rse, maya_ops). Autopager: escalation complete.
pagerduty-bot: pd note: Incident INC-4521 assigned to ben_rse.
ben_rse: leaving a short mitigation checklist in the incident ticket: 1) keep divert until new nodes ready, 2) provision nodepool fw v1.3.9, 3) verify no packet drops for 10m, 4) roll nodes back into service one at a time, 5) run postmortem templates.
maya_ops: will continue to monitor dashboards and update status page when we start reintroducing az2. thanks all. :thumbsup:
